readings.Aries: The competition you're engaged in — check that it's a competition you actually want to win. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Taurus: Beauty is not frivolous to you — it's structural. Without it, you cannot function well. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Gemini: Someone is taking your adaptability for granted. You have noticed. It's worth mentioning. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Cancer: Your memory holds things gently that others would have dropped. Today that gift is needed. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Leo: You radiate energy that others orient toward. Use this for good today — including your own good. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Virgo: The pursuit of precision is a form of care. Let it be received as such today. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Libra: The person you've been gentle with needs something less gentle today. You can do that. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Scorpio: Something you've been holding as a vulnerability is actually a source of power. Reframe it. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Sagittarius: Your optimism sometimes arrives before the data. Today the data is there. Let it inform the optimism. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Capricorn: You are more than your output. This requires repeating. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Aquarius: You've been ahead of the room for so long that you've stopped checking whether the room has caught up. Check. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Pisces: Something that feels like confusion is actually the process of integrating two incompatible things. Let it process. The window for this is shorter than it looks.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
